Bybit took in 151.0 million dollars, up from 91.7 million dollars, and Bitfinex took in 84.6 million dollars, up from 23.8 million dollars, which means dollars arrived at those venues where holders can sell. The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, was a 3.0 million dollar net outflow, 0.0011 percent of custodied value, compared with a 23.2 million dollar net outflow on the prior print, which means dollars that left Binance were met by larger arrivals at other venues.
